title: TropeCommitmentLedger Event
description: Append-only log of genre trope commitments. When a trope is activated (e.g. enemies-to-lovers), it creates required payoff beats. This ledger tracks which beats have been delivered and flags overdue ones. Trope library is defined per genre_profile.

scene_id.description: Scene where this trope event occurred.

trope_id.description: Trope identifier from the genre_profile.trope_library (e.g. enemies_to_lovers, forced_proximity, second_chance).

trope_name.description: Human-readable trope name for dashboard display.

genre_module.description: Genre module that defines this trope (e.g. romance_module_v1).

status.description: 'overdue' fires when a required beat is not delivered by its target scene.

activated_at_scene.description: Scene where this trope was first activated.

required_beats.description: Ordered list of beats this trope requires for valid resolution. Stub — beat list populated from genre_profile.trope_library during Phase 5 implementation.

beat_id.description: Scene beat where delivered. Null until fulfilled.
